description:
US-42 — SHORTER MESSAGES, TEXT ONLY. About 75 of the ~150 UI messages in src/i18n/de.ts get the shorter wording DF's developer agreed in a review: success messages name the result and stop; confirmations name what changes and stop; „Es wurde nichts gespeichert." and „Bitte erneut versuchen." go (the box colour says it, the button is still there); „Bitte die Seite neu laden." stays only where the screen is out of date; no rule rationale on screen; two hints dropped. EVERY exact new string is in the tables of tasks/prd-us-42-shorter-messages.md — copy them from there, character for character. NOTHING ELSE CHANGES: every button, link, confirmation step, reason field, tone, tier, data-testid and display condition stays as it is (PRD §„What must not change"); the only code edits are call sites of the three strings whose signature changes and the two hint

s removed. Out of scope: a „Neu laden" button in red notices. Both e2e engines stay green.

userStories.title: Success messages say the result and stop
userStories.description: As a staff member, I want a success message to name what happened in a few words, so I can read it at a glance and carry on. Source: tasks/prd-us-42-shorter-messages.md §US-42.1
acceptanceCriteria: Every key in the §US-42.1 table in src/i18n/de.ts reads EXACTLY the „New" column (punctuation and typographic quotes included); no other key's text changes
customers.archive.saved becomes a plain string with no parameter; call sites in src/app/kunden/[id]/page.tsx and src/app/ausgabe/page.tsx and every spec updated
customers.numberChange.saved drops its unused `from` parameter; src/app/kunden/[id]/number-control.tsx and specs updated

customers.reissue.saved returns ReadonlyArray<Segment> with the card number strong; both call sites (kunden/[id]/reissue-controls.tsx, karten-neuausstellung/page.tsx) render it bold; specs compare with plain(…)

„Rückgängig" still sits inside the Karten-drucken confirmation and still takes the tick back; „Korrigieren" still sits inside the counter's recorded confirmation; distribution.serve.recorded is unchanged
Doc comments above the changed keys in de.ts describe the new strings (e.g. archive.saved no longer claims to name the freed number)

NOTHING BUT TEXT CHANGES: every button/link/disclosure/reason field/confirmation step beside a changed message keeps its label, position and behaviour; notice-tier.ts is untouched; no tone, data-testid or data-tier changes; no condition for when a message shows changes (PRD §„What must not change")

npm run test:e2e AND npm run test:e2e:webkit pass (stop any leftover next dev / next start first). A spec broken by this story is migrated IN THIS STORY by comparing against the new de.* value (plain(…) for segments) — never by deleting or weakening an assertion

Driven and reviewed with the playwright-cli skill (accessibility snapshot, not only a screenshot): block → unblock, archive (record and counter footer), reissue (record and Karten neu ausstellen), number change, Karten drucken + Rückgängig, settings save
Full unit suite passes with coverage (domain and application stay at 100%): npm run test:coverage
Typecheck passes
Lint passes
